title.zh: Binance buys $100 million Circle stake in five-year USDC promotion deal
title.en: Binance buys $100 million Circle stake in five-year USDC promotion deal

current_state.zh: Binance在五年期USDC推广协议下持有Circle的1亿美元股份（1,237,011股A类股，每股80.84美元，私募交割于2026年9月17日完成），Circle按Binance持有的USDC数量每月支付激励费，Binance须开展额外推广活动；该协议取代2024年11月和2025年8月的协议。
current_state.en: Binance holds a $100 million stake in Circle (1,237,011 Class A shares at $80.84 each, private placement closed September 17, 2026) under a five-year USDC promotion deal in which Circle pays a monthly incentive fee based on USDC held and Binance performs additional promotional activities; the deal supersedes agreements from November 2024 and August 2025.

updates.title_zh: Binance Takes $100M Stake in Circle Under Five-Year USDC Promotion Deal
updates.title_en: Binance Takes $100M Stake in Circle Under Five-Year USDC Promotion Deal
updates.what_changed_zh: Circle以每股80.84美元向Binance发行1,237,011股A类股，通过私募配售筹集1亿美元，于2026年9月17日完成交割。五年期USDC推广协议取代了2024年11月和2025年8月的协议。Binance在最多两年内不得出售或对冲这些股份，但保留投票权。
updates.what_changed_en: Circle issued Binance 1,237,011 Class A shares at $80.84 each, raising $100 million in a private placement that closed September 17, 2026. The five-year USDC promotion deal supersedes agreements from November 2024 and August 2025. Binance cannot sell or hedge the shares for up to two years but retains voting rights.
updates.current_state_zh: Binance根据五年期USDC推广协议持有Circle的1亿美元股份（1,237,011股A类股），该协议于2026年9月17日完成，并取代了早先的协议。
updates.current_state_en: Binance holds a $100 million stake in Circle (1,237,011 Class A shares) under a five-year USDC promotion deal that closed September 17, 2026, and supersedes earlier agreements.

updates.title_zh: Binance takes $100M stake in Circle under expanded USDC deal
updates.title_en: Binance takes $100M stake in Circle under expanded USDC deal
updates.what_changed_zh: 根据扩大的五年期协议，Circle将按Binance通过Circle的模块化智能合约钱包基础设施持有的USDC数量，每月向Binance支付激励费；Binance还同意开展额外的USDC推广活动。若Binance在特定条件下终止商业协议，两年锁定期可提前结束。
updates.what_changed_en: Under the expanded five-year agreement, Circle will pay Binance a monthly incentive fee based on the amount of USDC held through Circle's Modular Smart Contract Wallet infrastructure, and Binance agreed to undertake additional USDC promotional activities. The two-year lockup can end earlier if Binance terminates the commercial agreement under certain conditions.
updates.current_state_zh: Binance在五年期USDC推广协议下持有Circle的1亿美元股份（1,237,011股A类股，每股80.84美元，私募交割于2026年9月17日完成），Circle按Binance持有的USDC数量每月支付激励费，Binance须开展额外推广活动；该协议取代2024年11月和2025年8月的协议。
updates.current_state_en: Binance holds a $100 million stake in Circle (1,237,011 Class A shares at $80.84 each, private placement closed September 17, 2026) under a five-year USDC promotion deal in which Circle pays a monthly incentive fee based on USDC held and Binance performs additional promotional activities; the deal supersedes agreements from November 2024 and August 2025.
